title: U.S. SEC's steadiest crypto advocate, Hester Peirce, to depart next week
summary: The long-anticipated exit of the commissioner sometimes known as Crypto Mom is Oct. 2, announced as the agency was sending out its latest crypto work.

title: Another appeals court rules against prediction market provider Kalshi, says sports contracts are subject to state regulations
summary: A Sixth Circuit Court of Appeals panel ruled that prediction markets' sports-related events contracts are not swaps, and therefore aren't subject to federal regulatory oversight.

title: Blockchain Association sees leadership shift shortly after crypto Clarity Act fizzles
summary: The trade group will be run again by its original CEO, Kristin Smith, when Summer Mersinger leaves at the end of a long congressional tussle.

title: Circle and Tether step in to freeze hacker wallet after massive Bitget crypto heist
summary: The stablecoin issuer blacklisted a wallet holding about $318,000 in USDT and USDC. Most of the stolen funds sit in ether, which can't be frozen.

title: Tokenization is moving faster than Washington
summary: Regulatory clarity is not simply a legal or political issue, argues former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo. It is an economic one.
